key_insight: Resource-efficient Knapsack QUBO formulations improve optimal-solution success rates, with a slackless approach delivering gains of several orders of magnitude.
engineering_relevance: Choosing a better QUBO formulation can reduce auxiliary-variable overhead or penalty strength while improving quantum optimization performance.
method: Derive a smaller penalty constant for the standard formulation.
Reduce the number of slack variables used to encode capacity constraints.
Use an alternative slackless QUBO formulation.
evidence_signal: All three approaches improve success probabilities in LR-QAOA simulations and on a D-Wave quantum annealer; the slackless method performs best, even for relatively small instances.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish whether these gains persist at larger scales or outperform classical Knapsack solvers.
paper_title: Resource-efficient formulations of the Knapsack problem for quantum computing
